title: Quest Foglight for Databases unzipFile Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. (CVE-2026-92197)
description: CVE-2026-92197 is a high-severity vulnerability in Quest Foglight for Databases involving a directory traversal flaw in the unzipFile method. This flaw allows authenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges by exploiting improper validation of user-supplied file paths.
